location.en: Maple Bay Language Institute, enrollment office

goal.en: Register for classes and get your student ID.
goal.zh: 完成課程註冊，拿到學生證。

background: small school enrollment office with a long wooden counter, a computer monitor, neat stacks of blank forms, a potted plant, a row of waiting chairs, sunny morning light

intro.en: Your first morning at the Maple Bay Language Institute. The hallway is full of new students holding coffee and papers.
intro.zh: 在楓灣語言學院的第一個早上。走廊上擠滿了拿著咖啡和文件的新生。

intro.en: You find the enrollment office. A woman with a pencil behind her ear looks up from her computer.
intro.zh: 你找到了註冊處。一位耳朵上夾著鉛筆的女士從電腦前抬起頭。

lines.en: Good morning! How can I help you today?
lines.zh: 早安！今天有什麼需要幫忙的嗎？

choices.tip: I'm here to + 原形動詞，一句話說清楚來意。到學校報到就說 I'm here to register.。

choices.en: Hello, I come here to report today.
choices.zh: 你好，我今天來這裡報到。

lines.en: Report? Did something happen? Should I call campus security?
lines.zh: 通報？發生什麼事了嗎？需要我叫校警嗎？

story.en: Diane picks up the phone to call security. It takes ten minutes to explain that nothing is wrong.
story.zh: 黛安拿起電話準備叫校警。你花了十分鐘才解釋清楚，其實什麼事都沒發生。

fail.why: 「報到」直譯成 report，聽起來像要「通報事件」。到學校報到要說 I'm here to register.，或 I'm here to check in for my classes.。

choices.en: Register me now. I'm in a hurry.
choices.zh: 幫我註冊，快點，我趕時間。

lines.en: Everyone's in a hurry on the first day. Please take a number.
lines.zh: 開學第一天大家都很趕。請先抽號碼牌。

story.en: Your number is 47. Diane is still helping number 12.
story.zh: 你抽到 47 號，黛安現在才叫到 12 號。

fail.why: Register me now. 是命令句，對櫃檯人員說會顯得很沒禮貌。就算趕時間，也先打招呼，再說 Hi, I'm here to register.。

lines.en: Welcome! First, please fill out this form.
lines.zh: 歡迎！首先，請填寫這份表格。

choices.en: Sure. Could I borrow a pen?
choices.zh: 好的。可以借我一支筆嗎？
choices.tip: Could I borrow...? 是禮貌地向人借東西。borrow 是「向別人借」，lend 是「借給別人」。

choices.en: Sure. Can you borrow me a pen?
choices.zh: 好的。你可以借我一支筆嗎？

lines.en: You want me to borrow a pen... from someone else, for you?
lines.zh: 你要我……去跟別人借一支筆給你？

story.en: Diane walks around the office asking people for a pen. By the time she comes back, your time slot is over.
story.zh: 黛安在辦公室裡到處跟人借筆。等她回來，你的報到時段已經結束了。

fail.why: borrow 是「向別人借」，主詞是借入的人。想請對方借你東西，要說 Could I borrow a pen? 或 Could you lend me a pen?。

choices.en: OK. I will write this form now.

lines.en: Write a new form? Oh no, the form is ready. Just fill it out.
lines.zh: 寫一張新表格？不用不用，表格已經做好了，填寫就好。

story.en: You start drawing boxes on the back of the paper. Diane gently hands you a fresh copy and a long sigh.
story.zh: 你開始在紙的背面畫格子。黛安輕輕遞給你一張新表格，還附上一聲長嘆。

fail.why: 「寫表格」直譯成 write the form，聽起來像要自己「設計」一張表。填表要說 fill out the form 或 fill in the form。

lines.en: You hand back the finished form.
lines.zh: 你把填好的表格交回去。

lines.en: Thanks. Now I need a photo for your student ID. Ready?
lines.zh: 謝謝。現在要幫你的學生證拍照，準備好了嗎？

choices.en: Almost. Can I fix my hair first?
choices.zh: 快好了。可以先整理一下頭髮嗎？
choices.tip: Can I ... first? 禮貌地請對方稍等一下。Almost. 表示「快好了」。

choices.en: Wait, wait. I'm not prepare yet.

lines.en: Not prepare... what? Oops, I already took it.
lines.zh: 沒準備……什麼？哎呀，我已經拍了。

story.en: Your student ID photo shows you mid-sentence with your mouth wide open. You will carry it for a whole year.
story.zh: 學生證上的你話說到一半，嘴巴張得大大的。這張照片你得帶在身上整整一年。

fail.why: I'm 後面要接形容詞，prepare 是動詞，不能直接放。要說 I'm not ready yet.，或 Wait, I'm not ready!。

choices.en: No photo, please. I look so ugly today.

lines.en: Sorry, no photo means no ID card. And you look fine!
lines.zh: 抱歉，沒照片就沒有學生證喔。而且你看起來很好啊！

story.en: Your student ID is printed with a gray shadow instead of a face. The library refuses to believe it's you.
story.zh: 你的學生證上印著一個灰色人影，沒有臉。圖書館怎麼樣都不相信那是你。

fail.why: 台灣人常用「我今天很醜」自嘲來化解尷尬，但英文直接這樣說，對方只會覺得你在拒絕拍照。想先準備一下，就說 Can I fix my hair first?。

lines.en: All done! Here's your student ID. Class starts at nine in Room 204.
lines.zh: 完成了！這是你的學生證。九點在 204 教室上課。

choices.en: Thanks! Which floor is Room 204 on?
choices.tip: Which floor is ... on? 用來問樓層，句尾的 on 不要漏掉。

choices.en: Thank you. You are very hard work.

lines.en: I'm... hard work? Am I difficult to deal with?
lines.zh: 我很……難搞？我很難應付嗎？

story.en: Diane spends the next few minutes wondering what she did wrong. Meanwhile, your first class starts without you.
story.zh: 黛安接下來幾分鐘都在想自己做錯了什麼。同一時間，你的第一堂課已經開始了。

fail.why: 「你辛苦了」直譯成 You are hard work，英文意思是「你很難搞」。想感謝對方幫忙，說 Thanks for your help! 就很到位。

choices.en: Nine? So early! Can I come at ten?
choices.zh: 九點？好早！我可以十點再來嗎？

lines.en: Class starts at nine for everyone, Kai.
lines.zh: 大家都是九點上課喔，凱。

story.en: Diane adds a note to your file: "Not a morning person." Your teacher reads it before your first class.
story.zh: 黛安在你的資料上加註：「早上爬不起來」。你的老師在第一堂課前就看到了。

fail.why: 報到第一天就抱怨上課太早，會給人很差的第一印象。上課時間是固定的，這時該問的是實用資訊，例如 Which floor is Room 204 on?。

lines.en: You look at your new student ID. The photo is not bad at all.
lines.zh: 你看著新的學生證，照片拍得還不錯。

lines.en: It's on the second floor. Welcome to the Institute, Kai!
lines.zh: 在二樓。歡迎來到語言學院，凱！

story.en: With your student ID in your pocket, you head upstairs to Room 204. Your school life in Maple Bay starts now.
story.zh: 學生證收進口袋，你走上樓前往 204 教室。你在楓灣的校園生活，現在開始。

notes.explain: 到櫃檯說明來意的萬用句型：I'm here to + 原形動詞。也可以說 I'm here to pick up my student ID.。

example.en: Hi, I'm here to register for the morning class.
example.zh: 你好，我來註冊早上的課。

notes.explain: 填表格用 fill out 或 fill in，不說 write the form。form 是表格，application form 是申請表。

example.en: Please fill out this form and sign at the bottom.
example.zh: 請填寫這份表格，並在最下面簽名。

notes.explain: borrow 是「向別人借」，lend 是「借給別人」。Could I borrow your pen? 等於 Could you lend me your pen?。

example.en: Could you lend me a pen? I left mine at home.
example.zh: 可以借我一支筆嗎？我的忘在家裡了。

notes.explain: student ID (card) 就是學生證，借書、買餐、進出大樓都會用到。ID 唸成 I-D 兩個字母。

example.en: Please show your student ID at the library.
example.zh: 在圖書館請出示學生證。

notes.explain: 「你辛苦了」不能直譯成 You are hard work，這句英文是「你很難搞」的意思。感謝別人幫忙說 Thanks for your help.。

example.en: Thanks for your help! Have a nice day.
example.zh: 謝謝你的幫忙！祝你有美好的一天。
